headline: Phase 3 is complete. H3 is rejected by G2, G3 and the supplementary latent-delay test, and the capacity account fails too: the deficit is architectural. TRM's greedy torque is much smoother, but it is less robust and 65x slower per decision. Write-ups are in 'Phase 3/': the summary of Phases 0-3, the Phase 3 paper, and the final report.

stage_notes.0: Complete: 24 headroom runs, 102/102 checkpoints re-evaluated (0 parameter mismatches), latency on a Xeon Gold 6342 and an A100. Deterministic Pendulum rollouts: every learning trunk reaches IQM about -120; all degrade similarly under delay mismatch (fine at d<=2, collapse at d>=3); TRM degrades faster under sensor noise.
stage_notes.1: Complete (72/72). At matched capacity TRM loses at both sizes (-50 small, -27 large); capacity moves neither family; H_cycles in {1, 3, 6} changes nothing while trm_h1 trains 2.6x faster than trm.
stage_notes.2: Complete (72/72). Medians (C1 / C3 / C4): MLP -178 / -294 / -235; Reset-Z TRM -227 / -271 / -334; Carry-Z -215 / -300 / -333; carried LSTM -252 / -786 / -371. The previous-action input closes most of the MLP's C4 gap on its own.
stage_notes.3: Not run: G2 failed (plan §4.3). The TD3 port and the InvertedDoublePendulum config are built but unused.
stage_notes.4: Not run: G3 failed (Carry-Z never beats Reset-Z).

amendments.title: Theory check on the headroom probe
amendments.text: With i.i.d. per-step delay, a fully observed plant and the 4-slot pending queue, the augmented observation is already Markov, so the oracle arm's realised past delay carries no usable information. G0 as written would fail by construction.

amendments.title: Arm A4 and an amended G0
amendments.text: Added: MLP at stochastic delay with no augmentation (+6 jobs). G0 passes on either oracle headroom (A3 - A2) or memory headroom (A2 - A4), same criterion as before.

amendments.title: Stage 2 co-primary
amendments.text: The C4 (no-augmentation) replication of the interaction contrast becomes co-primary with C3.

amendments.title: Exact discrete-uniform delay
amendments.text: d ~ U{0..4} is drawn exactly; the old 'uniform' option under-weights the endpoints.

amendments.title: GPU placement
amendments.text: Every job runs on a GPU node. The battery runs as 12 shard jobs and latency as one job; each result records its device.

amendments.title: Stage 2 inputs
amendments.text: Every Stage 2 trunk, the MLP included, sees the previous executed action, so the trunks differ only in architecture and memory.
